# TCM Way

> Classical Chinese medicine explained in plain English — no jargon, no
> mysticism. Articles, an audio podcast, and illustrations for a Western
> audience. This file lists the site's key pages for LLM access.

## Start Here

- [TCM Way home](https://tcmway.net/): Site home and latest articles.
- [Archive](https://tcmway.net/archive.html): Full article archive.
- [Podcast — East & Inner with Ollie](https://tcmway.net/podcast/): Audio podcast,
  one episode per blog article, plus an RSS feed at /podcast/feed.xml.
- [About](https://tcmway.net/about.html): What TCM Way is and who writes it.
